title: Dynamic precision signatures and calibration sentinel for per-model defaults
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: define and implement a per-model 'precision signature' and an automated 'calibration sentinel' that together recommend a default quantization profile (FP8/INT8) for each catalog entry, validate accuracy across representative workloads, and provide deterministic rollback guardrails. The work should produce a stable recommendation surface used by the model catalog UI and by runtime rollout policies. The focus is on measurable accuracy bands, sensitivity fingerprints, and automated fallback chains to prevent production regressions.
acceptance_criteria: A precision signature is computed for new/imported models and stored in the catalog metadata
Calibration sentinel runs a sensitivity sweep (FP8/INT8 +/- per-layer perturbation) and emits recommended default profile and confidence band
If accuracy delta vs baseline exceeds configured tolerances, the sentinel flags the model and selects a safe fallback (higher precision or per-shard hybrid)
Shadow rollout harness can validate recommended defaults on customer-like traffic with token-level latency and quality telemetry
CI gate prevents merge of profile changes that cause regression beyond 0.75% end-task metric or >2% token-level perplexity delta on canonical evals
implementation_notes: Build lightweight signature vector: layer-wise activation distribution stats + per-layer weight quantization sensitivity estimate + sequence-length performance sketch
Run multi-stage calibration: 1) global FP8/INT8 pass, 2) per-layer sensitivity scan (hotspot layers flagged), 3) hybrid per-shard suggestion (e.g., shard0=INT8, shard1=FP8)
Calibration sentinel is a separate pipeline that stores artifacts: raw calibration traces, recommended profile JSON, and 'confidence_band' numeric score
Recommendation ranking includes cost delta, latency delta, and quality delta so product can present tradeoffs in Catalog UI
Guardrails: automatic fallback chains, a deterministic rollout plan (shadow -> canary -> gradual), and a rollback token that pins runtime to prior precision signature
Expose APIs for runtime to query 'recommended_profile' and 'fallback_profile' with TTL and provenance hash
test_plan: Unit tests for signature generation (synthetic layers with known distributions)
Integration test: calibration sentinel produces expected profile on small LLaMA-style model replica
Regression harness: run recommended profile vs baseline on canonical eval sets (summarization, code, instruction-following) and assert metric thresholds
Shadow rollout against sampled production traces for 72 hours and compare token-level latency and top-level accuracy metrics
Chaos test: inject quantization perturbation to ensure fallback chain triggers and runtime correctly pins to fallback_profile
